packets.verdict: Source and formulation audit passes for the seven recommendations; dated literature evidence remains bounded.
findings: The thesis explicitly says it usually works in ZF+AD (physical21); adding DC_R everywhere merely because the newer paper uses it would alter source scope.
Arithmetic regression and hyperarithmetic order preservation are distinct questions. Cone definitions and invariance requirements in the standalone texts match the corresponding degree structures.

Definition5.32 uses reducibility in both directions, not existence of a witnessing bijection. The text correctly preserves this weak Rudin–Keisler convention, which differs under AD from a usual ZFC characterization.

Strictly below, distinct equivalent, two specified Lebesgue/Baire ultrafilters, and maximality are different full targets. The Lebesgue/Baire subcase is explicitly related to strict-below, so these should carry relation links when integrated.
The theorem for measure-preserving functions uses stronger axioms; Question9.8 is specifically the ZF strength of the Borel case, and is not answered by merely citing that theorem.

packets.verdict: Source and formulation audit passes for the nine recommendations; dated literature evidence remains bounded.
findings: The input length n, rather than matrix side 2^n, is the variable in the source polylogarithmic communication-class convention (physical16). The equality-oracle separation text using polynomial in log n is correct.

Large monochromatic rectangle means both side cardinalities are bounded below by a constant fraction, not only large product area. The standalone general, gamma-two and XOR-lift questions preserve this.

Question6.1 asks size separation, while Question6.2 asks Fourier-norm separation. Constant randomized depth implies constant randomized size, and large Fourier norm lower-bounds deterministic size; these are related but not identical targets.

The entrywise-AND sign convention is min on ±1 entries. The gamma-two conjecture is for0/1 matrices; the standalone definition uses the actual Boolean matrix rather than silently changing to sign matrices.
Conjecture6.8 explicitly concerns a constant affine coset. The theorem requires affine connectivity of both set and complement; removing that hypothesis is still a distinct question.
The source states R(PL)=omega(1) in Conjecture6.4; root records a fresh primary April2026 closure rather than treating it as a new question. Question6.5 and unspecified-bound6.7 remain holds.

limits: This is an independent actual-source/scope audit and cross-packet comparison. It does not independently certify the nonexistence of later literature or verify proofs in every cited new preprint.
